topography.project_purpose: Dexs. Structurally: 46 project-authored contract(s) across 1 chain(s); 1 ERC4626 vault, 5 ERC20 tokens, 2 ERC721 NFTs; role-gated via AccessControl; upgradeable via ERC1967/UUPS proxies; built on openzeppelin.
topography.relationship_narrative: The protocol comprises 9 functional families. Its contracts share 6 common project-authored base contract(s) (multicall, blocktimestamp, peripheryimmutablestate). Dominant framework: openzeppelin.
